source.author: verg
source.text: Magno discordes aethere venti proelia ceu tollunt animis et viribus aequis; non ipsi inter se, non nubila, non mare cedit; anceps pugna diu, stant obnixa omnia contra:
source.text_original: Magno discordes aethere venti / proelia ceu tollunt animis et viribus aequis; / non ipsi inter se, non nubila, non mare cedit; / anceps pugna diu, stant obnixa omnia contra: /
source.text_english: With great violence the winds, at odds in the sky, raise battle, as though in equal spirit and strength; neither among themselves, nor the clouds, nor the sea gives way; the struggle is long uncertain, all stand braced in opposition:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: superum quando consulta videtis, o socii quantisque datur spes maxima coeptis! vos quoque nunc vires animosque afferte paternos.
reuse.text_original: 'superum quando consulta videtis, / o socii (quantisque datur spes maxima coeptis!) / vos quoque nunc vires animosque afferte paternos.
reuse.text_english: Since you see the decisions of the gods above, comrades, and since the greatest hope is granted to our great undertakings, you too now bring your fathers’ strength and spirit.
